terms.heading: Terms of Service
terms.intro: vibefly.ai is a web design and hosting service operated by motiveFx LLC, based in Naugatuck, Connecticut.

sections.heading: 1. What We Do
sections.body: vibefly builds and hosts websites for small businesses. You provide us with the information and content for your site — your business details, copy, images, and preferences. We design, build, and host it for you.

sections.heading: 2. Payments
sections.body:
Launch fee: You'll review and approve your finished site before we send an invoice. Because you've seen and signed off on the work, launch fees are non-refundable.

Monthly subscription: Hosting and ongoing AI-assisted edits are billed monthly. You can cancel at any time — no notice period required. Your service continues through the end of the current billing period, then ends. No partial refunds are issued for unused time.

Site availability: If your subscription ends or is canceled, your site will be taken down at the close of the billing period. Your content will not be retained after that point.

sections.heading: 3. Your Responsibilities
sections.body: You're responsible for the accuracy and legality of the content you provide. Don't send us anything you don't have the right to use. By giving us your content, you confirm you have permission to use it.

sections.heading: 4. AI-Generated Content
sections.body: vibefly uses AI tools to assist in generating website copy, structure, and content suggestions. All AI-generated content is reviewed and delivered to you as part of our service. You are responsible for reviewing that content for accuracy, appropriateness, and compliance with applicable laws before your site goes live. By approving your site, you accept responsibility for the content it contains.

sections.heading: 5. Our Work
sections.body: We retain the right to display completed sites in our portfolio and for promotional purposes. If you'd prefer we not showcase your site, just let us know and we'll honor that request.

sections.heading: 6. Limitation of Liability
sections.body: vibefly.ai and motiveFx LLC are not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages — including lost revenue or data — arising from use of our services. Our total liability in any dispute is limited to the amount you paid us in the 30 days preceding the claim.

sections.heading: 7. Changes to These Terms
sections.body: We may update these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the service after changes are posted means you accept the updated terms.

sections.heading: 8. Domain Registration and Ownership
sections.body:
When you purchase domain registration through vibefly.ai, the domain is registered using your name and contact information — you are the rightful owner. The domain is held and managed in our Cloudflare account on your behalf for the duration of your service.

WHOIS privacy protection is always enabled at no additional charge. Your personal contact information will not appear in public domain records.

If your subscription ends or you request a transfer, we will initiate a domain transfer to the registrar of your choice within 5 business days of receiving your request or final billing period end. You are responsible for providing a valid transfer destination. We will hold the domain for up to 90 days after service ends while awaiting transfer instructions. After 90 days, we reserve the right to release or let the domain expire if no transfer has been completed.

You are responsible for any transfer fees charged by the receiving registrar. We do not charge a transfer fee.

sections.heading: 9. Indemnification
sections.body: You agree to indemnify and hold harmless vibefly.ai and motiveFx LLC, its officers, employees, and agents, from any claims, damages, losses, or expenses (including reasonable legal fees) arising out of or relating to: (a) the content you provide for your website, (b) your use of our services, (c) your violation of these Terms, or (d) any claim that your content infringes the intellectual property or other rights of a third party.

sections.heading: 10. Accessibility
sections.body:
vibefly.ai builds websites using modern, semantic HTML and follows general web best practices. However, we do not guarantee that any website we build will comply with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG), or any other accessibility standard or regulation.

You are responsible for ensuring that your website meets any accessibility requirements applicable to your business. If you have specific accessibility requirements, please let us know before work begins and we will do our best to accommodate them.

sections.heading: 11. Force Majeure
sections.body: vibefly.ai and motiveFx LLC are not liable for any failure or delay in performance caused by circumstances beyond our reasonable control, including but not limited to internet or infrastructure outages, third-party service failures (including Cloudflare, AWS, or other providers), natural disasters, acts of government, or other events outside our control.

sections.heading: 12. Dispute Resolution
sections.body:
We'd rather resolve any issue quickly and directly. If you have a concern, please contact us at info@vibefly.ai first and give us a reasonable opportunity to address it.

If a dispute cannot be resolved informally, it will be subject to binding arbitration under the rules of the American Arbitration Association (AAA), conducted in Connecticut. You waive any right to participate in a class action lawsuit or class-wide arbitration. Nothing in this section prevents either party from seeking emergency injunctive relief in a court of competent jurisdiction.

sections.heading: 13. Governing Law
sections.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the State of Connecticut, without regard to conflict of law principles.

sections.heading: Questions?
sections.body: Email us at info@vibefly.ai

privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: vibefly.ai is operated by motiveFx LLC, based in Naugatuck, Connecticut. This policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and how we protect it.

sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
sections.body:
When you fill out a contact form on vibefly.ai, we collect your name, email address, phone number (if provided), company name (if provided), and your message.

We don't collect payment information directly — payments are processed through Stripe, which has its own privacy policy.

sections.heading: 2. How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use your information to respond to your inquiry, provide and manage the services you've requested, and communicate with you about your project or account. We do not sell, rent, or share your information with third parties for marketing purposes.

sections.heading: 3. Infrastructure and Third-Party Services
sections.body:
Our platform runs on Cloudflare, which handles website hosting, DNS, and security (including Turnstile bot protection). Cloudflare may process traffic data as part of normal operations.

We use Stripe for payment processing. Stripe collects and handles payment data independently under their own privacy policy.

sections.heading: 4. Data Retention
sections.body: We retain your contact information as long as we have an active business relationship with you. If you'd like us to delete your data, contact us and we'll take care of it promptly.

sections.heading: 5. Your Rights
sections.body: You have the right to request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information at any time. Just reach out and we'll respond within a reasonable timeframe.

sections.heading: 6. Cookies
sections.body: We don't run advertising or tracking cookies. Cloudflare may set security-related cookies as part of bot protection.

sections.heading: 7. Changes to This Policy
sections.body: We may update this policy occasionally. The effective date at the top of this page will reflect the latest revision.

sections.heading: 8. Email Communications
sections.body:
When you contact us through our website or become a client, we may send you transactional emails related to your project, account, or service updates. We do not send marketing emails without your consent.

If you receive any email from us you didn't expect, contact us at info@vibefly.ai and we'll take care of it.

sections.heading: 9. California Privacy Rights (CCPA)
sections.body: If you are a California resident, you have the right to know what personal information we collect, request deletion of your personal information, and opt out of any sale of personal information. We do not sell personal information. To exercise your rights, contact us at info@vibefly.ai. We will respond within 45 days.

sections.heading: 10. International Users
sections.body:
Our services are operated in the United States. If you are accessing our site from outside the U.S., please be aware that your information may be transferred to and processed in the United States, where data protection laws may differ from those in your country.

If you are located in the European Economic Area (EEA), the United Kingdom, or Switzerland, by using our services you consent to this transfer. Our legal basis for processing your data is the performance of a contract and our legitimate business interests. You have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your data by contacting us at info@vibefly.ai.

sections.heading: 11. Age Restrictions
sections.body: Our services are intended for use by businesses and adults aged 18 and over. We do not knowingly collect personal information from anyone under 18. If you believe a minor has submitted information to us, please contact us at info@vibefly.ai and we will promptly delete it.

sections.heading: 12. Governing Law
sections.body: This policy is governed by the laws of the State of Connecticut.
